usedFor: Platoforms holds PDF forms, and Moco receives a lead through “Create Deal” each time a “Form Created” fires.

bestTemplate.name: “Form Created” in Platoforms, then “Create Deal” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: It creates a lead in Moco with a name, contact, company, tags and dates.

watchOut: “Form Created” is checked on a schedule, so the Moco lead appears a little after the form.
